planets.name: HD 3167 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 3167 with a 0.96-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: HD 3167 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around HD 3167. Its orbit and size follow Coy et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname COY_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2016, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 0.95965451, pl_radj 0.1428319, pl_bmassj 0.01524093

quotes.title: HD 3167 b
quotes.card: HD 3167 b is a super-Earth exoplanet that orbits the K-type star HD 3167.
quotes.introduction: With an orbital period of just 0.959 days, it belongs to the group of ultra-short period planets.
